fixes.explanation: Covenant is a big Bible word, so I get the guess, but it isn't in this verse. After "…bless His name…" the writer says to "proclaim His salvation day after day." Day after day! That's not a one-time announcement, that's a lifestyle. Like a baker who keeps the oven on, the word to keep sharing is salvation.

Angels is a good guess, friend, but that's not the word the writer picks. He says, "…all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens." Idols are things people make, and the LORD is the One who made the heavens. I think the writer is saying the gods of the nations can't even compare.
